notice: Dataset and source registry for the EMXplore Radio Astronomy project. Sources with visibility 'private' are research files that are not distributed. They are referenced only by opaque logical IDs; storage locations and checksums are kept in a private local-source manifest outside this public registry. Private project records are never quoted; they may only support neutral 'inferred' notes. Historical products keep their original calibration epoch (see calibration-epochs.json).

data_levels.L0: Native spectral acquisition: averaged power spectra as written by the acquisition software (NOT raw I/Q), or the same values resampled to a common grid (product_class resampled_spectra).
data_levels.L1: Observation organisation: scan manifests, pointing tracks, session metadata.
data_levels.L2: Reduced spectra: baseline/bandpass removed, quality-gated, still on a relative scale.
data_levels.L3: Calibrated spectra: values on a temperature scale of a named calibration epoch.
data_levels.L5: Derived science products: peak/velocity/moment maps, catalogues, velocity tables, fitted calibration constants.
data_levels.L6: Curated / corrected products: selection rules, stray-radiation or other corrections, multi-session composites.
data_levels.L7: Visualization: figures and renderings made from lower levels.
data_levels.L8: Independently reproduced publication products: regenerated from L0/L1 by documented code with a recorded lineage.

datasets.title: 26 Aug 2026 outer-Galaxy raster: native averaged spectra (776 NPZ)

observation_time.note: Chunk timestamps are the save time at the END of each averaging window. The folder name '0547' is local time (UTC+3).

processing_status.value: Welch-averaged power spectra only; schema A additionally divided by a stored background

datasets.student_notes: Strongest supplied end-to-end reproducible campaign: native spectra + manifest + every downstream product level. Recommended first dataset for reduction, repeatability and velocity work.

scientific_purpose.value: Map outer-arm H I brightness and velocity structure across l = 146-226 deg

files.note: Two schemas: see facts. Checksums are held in the private local-source manifest.

produced_by.value: Legacy acquisition software (V62 native accumulator and original autosave path)
produced_by.note: Exact build used on 26 Aug is not recorded in the files; schema A/B match the two code paths.

facts.note: 301 channels, 1420.10-1420.80 MHz, L_used 50, background-divided corr_lin/corr_dB present; spectral span follows the GUI zoom grid.
Recorded values may not equal the hardware state (audit finding S7).

limitations.value: Not raw I/Q: Welch-averaged power spectra
lst_hours is 0.0 and device is empty in every file; NPZ files carry no pointing
__meta__ is a pickled object array (requires allow_pickle when reading)
Schema A background (corr) is on a different power scale (corr/avg about 0.005-0.007) and the background file is not supplied
HackRF sample-format conversion unverified
Morning session; the Sun may contribute through sidelobes late in the session
limitations.note: Only the all-sky product mentions a dawn Sun band; its effect on this session is not quantified.
